name: Superfluid IDA forged callAgreement context
summary: Superfluid agreements decoded the ctx bytes from caller-shaped call data without checking the host's ctx stamp. Through Host.callAgreement the attacker passed a forged context naming victims as msgSender, created and updated IDA indexes as those accounts, distributed their super-token balances to itself and downgraded them.

loss.notes: Victim super-token depletion measured by the attacker's downgrades in source-2 across 24 victim (token, account) pairs. Illiquid tokens whose disposal moved the market (QI, MOCA, SDT, STACK) and sdam3CRV use realised proceeds; USDC.e at par; WETH and MATIC at DefiLlama quotes. The aggregate combines bases, hence method other. The theft completed in source-2 at 1644301024; realizedAt is the last attacker disposal used for the realised-proceeds valuation (second MOCA sale, block 24766896).

ageReset.description: Last pre-exploit CodeUpdated on the IDA proxy activated implementation 0x07711bb6dfbc99a1df1f2d7f57545a67519941e7, whose inlined AgreementLibrary.authorizeTokenAccess accepts an unstamped ctx; it stayed active until the fix upgrade at block 24695087.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and earliest use. Attacker EOA 0x1574f7f4c9d3aca2ebce918e5d19d18ae853c090 (Etherscan V2 account.txlist chainid=137) deploys exploit contract 0x32d47ba0affc9569298d4598f7bf8348ce8da6d4 in 0xefdb283016fd9a7e09471fbc237431df5a4401625a1f3c21321496de65e52303 (block 24684669), then sends source-1 (block 24684714, index 73, selector 0x3848e794), source-2 (block 24685148, index 43, selector 0x862122c6) and source-3 (block 24685175, payout of the underlying tokens to the EOA). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1: 24 successful Superfluid host (proxy 0x3e14dc1b13c488a8d5d310918780c983bd5982e7) callAgreement(address,bytes,bytes) calls, agreement = IDA proxy 0xb0aabba4b2783a72c52956cdef62d438eca2d7a1 (delegating to 0x07711bb6dfbc99a1df1f2d7f57545a67519941e7), inner createIndex(address,uint32,bytes) 0xd787840a whose ctx argument is not the host placeholder but an attacker-encoded context (ctx offset 0x80, length 0x260) carrying a victim as msgSender, e.g. first call: token QIx 0xe1ca10e6a10c0f72b74df6b7339912babfb1f8b5, indexId 0x181e5, forged msgSender 0x5073c1535a1a238e7c7438c553f1a2baac366cee. The host appends the genuine ctx after the call data, but ABI decoding in the agreement follows the attacker-set offset; AgreementLibrary.authorizeTokenAccess (source-5) checks only token.getHost()==msg.sender and passes the forged bytes to host.decodeCtx without isCtxValid, so the IDA acts for the impersonated account. Receipt: 23 IndexCreated (topic 0x01ab8663...) with the victims as publisher. Source-2 repeats the forgery as each victim: updateSubscription 0x232d2b58 (units for the attacker contract), updateIndex 0x7fbc7639 (distributes the victim's entire balance), claim 0xacafa1b8, then downgrades the received super tokens (loss note). Earliest use: Etherscan getLogs IndexCreated on the IDA proxy, blocks 0..24684713, returns 157 logs in 90 distinct (tx, publisher) pairs; callTracer of each shows a frame from the publisher to the host, i.e. the publisher itself called; every pre-exploit publisher has code (super apps). Blocks 24684714..24695087 (fix upgrade) return only source-1 logs, none with a publisher-to-host frame. The forged-ctx path therefore first succeeds in source-1. Fix: IDA/CFA upgrade to 0x7b836cb9a1b0ef8aadc18b74270e04f78a790399 at block 24695087 (tx 0x5901d290c26128ce4c0a720750ee6921751a415291913cfb05e417c64aeb8756), matching source-6, which adds require(isCtxValid(ctx)) to authorizeTokenAccess.

Verified InstantDistributionAgreementV1 source for 0x07711bb6dfbc99a1df1f2d7f57545a67519941e7: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=137, compiler v0.7.6+commit.7338295f, optimizer 200 runs, standard-JSON input; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string (jq -j) f2e717f158b63ee4873c6a50e8262718364760fa537a6f5d9a62b1f5d983c4c4. /contracts/agreements/AgreementLibrary.sol lines 39-45: authorizeTokenAccess(token, ctx) requires token.getHost()==msg.sender and returns ISuperfluid(msg.sender).decodeCtx(ctx); isCtxValid appears only in the ISuperfluid interface. createIndex, updateIndex and updateSubscription take the publisher/subscriber from the decoded context.msgSender.

Reviewed target identity and age history. IDA proxy 0xb0aabba4b2783a72c52956cdef62d438eca2d7a1: source-9 (block 11650637, index 2) callTracer shows CREATE from the Superfluid host 0x3e14dc1b13c488a8d5d310918780c983bd5982e7; eth_getCode empty at 11650636, runtime keccak 0x22c46bf619653d8030cec3f4d4ef449ef08059e3bb371707a84ab180bd5a48ca (516 bytes) at 11650637 and 24684713. Implementation 0x07711bb6dfbc99a1df1f2d7f57545a67519941e7: source-7 top-level creation by 0xd15d5d0f5b1b56a4daef75cfe108cb825e97d015 at block 20311821 index 4; code empty at 20311820, keccak 0x1709d26debca6cc163f09692f7834edfc5454e42e257dfbc93d4b6931d66fa8e (24173 bytes) at 20311821 and 24684713. Etherscan getLogs on the proxy, topic0 CodeUpdated(bytes32,address) 0xe011bc04c286c344a8fcbb8de77f953da762c3e25d8cdea984147fc4168a5dcc, blocks 0..30000000: pre-exploit events at blocks 13345908 (0x946f8e5f7bae2ff6dfea0fc213328c96c0ff145f), 18091514 (0xf21019b8688e7730ca6d9002569ecbaf8d1a3083), 18638675 (0x14969a18c6d0a29894dcdf776f86e1e4ee8f3a11) and 20312137 (source-8, index 5, log 25, data word 1 = 0x07711bb6...); the next is the post-exploit fix at 24695087. EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1...2bbc at block 24684713 holds 0x07711bb6.... Source-8 is a governance multisig (0x1eb3faa360bf1f093f5a18d21f21f13d769d044a) confirmTransaction that routes the host's agreement-class update to the proxy. The unchecked-ctx defect sits in the IDA implementation (source-6 fixes the agreement, not the host), so the latest code activation of that artifact, source-8, supplies the age; earlier implementations with the same library code are superseded. The host implementation 0xebbe9a6688be25d058c9469ee4807e5ef192897f also executed but is not modified by the fix and is not a target.

Reviewed gross loss. (0x1a4/0x1a5); MOCAx 0x1adca32b... 1507930872323546950873022 -> MOCA 0xce899f26... (0x1a8/0x1a9); STACKx 0xcae73e9e... 23653162335108978358778 -> STACK 0xccbe9b81... The attacker contract, created 479 blocks earlier, received these balances only through the forged distributions: summed balanceOf decreases of the 24 (token, victim) pairs between blocks 24685147 and 24685148 equal each downgrade plus at most 0.65 token units per asset (streaming accrual/rounding), so the downgraded amounts are the conservative victim depletion. Source-3 forwards all of them to the EOA.
